tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Create a Formpit form for an HTML form on any website, including static sites with no backend (contact form, waitlist, feedback, quote request). Returns the endpoint to use as the form's action and a ready-to-paste HTML snippet. Submissions are emailed to the account owner and land in their Formpit

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: List the forms on this Formpit account with their endpoints and how many submissions are unanswered.

tools.name: list_submissions
tools.description: List submissions for one form, newest first. Defaults to unanswered ("new") ones.

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: Read one submission in full: every field the visitor sent, notes, tags and the email conversation so far.

tools.name: reply_to_submission
tools.description: Email a reply to the person who sent a submission. This sends a real email to a real person: show the user the exact text and get their explicit go-ahead before calling. The reply only ever goes to the address the visitor entered, and their answer comes back into the same Formpit conversation. Marks

tools.name: set_status
tools.description: Mark a submission as new, replied or closed.

tools.name: get_usage
tools.description: Show the plan, submissions used this month and replies sent in the last 24 hours.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "reply_to_submission" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Email a reply to the person who sent a submission. This sends a real email to a real person: show the user the exact text and get their explicit go-ahead before…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_submission, reply_to_submission · Private data: create_form · Public sink: get_submission, reply_to_submission.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_submission, reply_to_submission · Private data: create_form · Public sink: get_submission, reply_to_submission

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
